thesis: 廣告基礎設施 AI 化進入強制期：Google 強制遷移 DSA、ChatGPT 廣告全球擴張、iOS 27 Siri AI 三路並進，Agency 若非主動適應，便是被動接受。
thesis_en: September marks AI advertising infrastructure's mandatory phase — Google's forced DSA migration, ChatGPT Ads global rollout, and iOS 27 Siri AI all arriving simultaneously, leaving agencies no choice but to adapt.
thesis_note: 本週每個主要廣告平台都在主動或強制推進 AI 升級：Google 向 DSA 廣告系列下達 AI Max 強制遷移令；OpenAI ChatGPT 廣告向歐洲及印度全面開放；Apple iOS 27 正在改寫行動搜尋介面。三大變動同期發生，說明 AI 廣告基礎設施的整合已不再是選擇題。
thesis_note_en: This week, every major ad platform is pushing AI upgrades — Google mandating AI Max migration for DSA campaigns, OpenAI opening ChatGPT Ads to Europe and India, and Apple's iOS 27 rebuilding the mobile search experience. Three simultaneous shifts confirm that AI advertising infrastructure is no longer optional — it is the new baseline.
sources_note_en: Sources: CNBC, Forbes, 36kr, Google, OpenAI, Reuters, The Drum, Marketing-Interactive, Kling AI

items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.title: 四大 AI 廠商於一週內接連發布新模型，企業買家陷入選型疲勞
items.title_en: Four major AI labs release new models in one week — enterprise 'model fatigue' sets in
items.summary: Anthropic、Meta、Google、OpenAI 於同一週各自發布新版模型，企業評估資源接近極限，業界 CTO 直言「模型疲勞」正在蔓延。
items.summary_en: All four major AI labs launched new models in the same week, overwhelming enterprise procurement teams. Executives warn of 'model fatigue' as release cycles outpace internal evaluation capacity.
items.why: 品牌客戶難以選型，具備 AI 工具評估專長的 Agency 顧問需求上升。
items.why_en: Brands can't self-navigate the AI tool landscape — agencies with model evaluation expertise gain advisory value.
highlights: Anthropic、Meta、Google、OpenAI 四家在同一週各推新版模型，企業 IT 採購周期完全跟不上發布速度。
多位跨國企業 CTO 公開表示陷入「模型疲勞」，內部資源不足以完成充分的安全與效益評估。
模型發布競賽加劇，反令擅長 AI 工具選型的 Agency 在品牌顧問市場獲得新定位。
highlights_en: All four top AI labs released new models in the same week, creating an evaluation backlog that enterprise IT teams cannot absorb.
Multiple Fortune 500 CTOs publicly cited 'model fatigue' — internal capacity for thorough model assessment has hit a ceiling.
The arms race paradoxically benefits agencies with AI tool expertise, as brands increasingly outsource model selection.
items.pattern: Agency 可藉此打造「AI 工具評選」顧問服務，以獨立第三方身份協助品牌客戶制定 AI 工具採購策略，開拓新的收費項目。
items.pattern_en: Agencies can package 'AI tool evaluation' as a new consulting service — acting as independent experts helping brands navigate model selection strategy.

items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.title: 雷軍發布小米 18 Fold，預告 AI 加速器晶片 2027 年商用
items.title_en: Lei Jun launches Xiaomi 18 Fold, previews XRing O100 AI accelerator chip for 2027 commercial rollout
items.summary: 小米 18 Fold 搭載自研玄戒 O3 晶片正式發布，雷軍於發布會上預告 AI 加速器 XRing O100 與自駕晶片 D100 將於 2027 年商業落地，三芯片戰略成形。
items.summary_en: Xiaomi 18 Fold launches with the in-house XRing O3 chip as Lei Jun previews XRing O100 AI accelerator and D100 autonomous driving chip for 2027 commercial release.
items.why: 中國硬體廠商全棧自研 AI 晶片，端側 AI 自主化加速，衝擊大灣區 AI 工具生態。
items.why_en: China's hardware self-sufficiency in AI chips accelerates on-device AI independence, reshaping the local AI tool and content creation landscape.
highlights: 小米 18 Fold 採用 3nm 製程玄戒 O3 旗艦晶片，性能全面對標 Apple A20 Pro，AnTuTu 跑分逾 523 萬。
XRing O100 AI 加速器晶片與 D100 自駕晶片均於發布會現場亮相，預計 2027 年量產商用。
小米三款自研晶片路線圖同步披露，是中國科技企業算力自主化的重要里程碑。
highlights_en: Xiaomi 18 Fold ships with the in-house XRing O3 chip on a 3nm process, benchmarking directly against Apple's A20 Pro with an AnTuTu score exceeding 5.23 million.
XRing O100 AI accelerator and D100 autonomous driving chips were previewed for 2027 mass production.
Three in-house chips announced in one event — Xiaomi's most explicit statement of compute self-sufficiency to date.

items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.title: Apple 明日發布 iPhone 18，iOS 27 攜 Gemini 驅動全新 Siri AI 改寫行動搜尋
items.title_en: Apple unveils iPhone 18 tomorrow — iOS 27 brings Gemini-powered Siri AI, reshaping mobile search
items.summary: Apple 9 月 9 日舉行新品發布，iPhone 18 Pro 與摺疊機 iPhone Ultra 亮相，iOS 27 全新 Siri AI 採用 Google Gemini，預計 9 月 14 日推出。
items.summary_en: Apple's September 9 event reveals iPhone 18 Pro and foldable iPhone Ultra; iOS 27 ships September 14 with a fully rebuilt Siri AI powered by Google Gemini.
items.why: iOS 27 Siri AI 上線觸及 HK 逾六成 iPhone 用戶，App 廣告與行動搜尋格局將隨之改變。
items.why_en: iOS 27 Siri AI reaching over 60% of HK users means app advertising and mobile search dynamics will shift — prepare now.
highlights: iPhone 18 Pro 搭載 A20 Pro (2nm) 晶片，配合 iOS 27 全新 Siri AI，支援複雜多步驟任務與情境感知指令。
iOS 27 Siri AI 底層採用 Google Gemini 技術，是迄今最大規模的 Siri 架構重建，iOS 27 預計 9 月 14 日推出。
首款摺疊機 iPhone Ultra 亦於現場發布，標誌 Apple 正式進入可摺疊形態裝置市場。
highlights_en: iPhone 18 Pro features an A20 Pro (2nm) chip paired with iOS 27's rebuilt Siri AI, supporting multi-step complex tasks and context-aware commands.
iOS 27 Siri AI runs on Google Gemini under the hood — the biggest Siri architecture change in its history; iOS 27 launches September 14.
First-ever foldable iPhone Ultra debuts alongside the Pro, marking Apple's entry into the foldable device category.
items.pattern: iOS 27 推出後，Apple Search Ads 的廣告競標邏輯及 App Store 曝光規則可能同步調整，Agency 須於 9 月 14 日後密切追蹤 Apple 廣告政策更新。
items.pattern_en: With Siri AI rebuilt in iOS 27, Apple Search Ads bidding logic and App Store ad placement rules may update. Watch for Apple Ads policy changes post-September 14.

items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.title: Google 啟動 DSA 強制升級至 AI Max，9 月已開始自動遷移部分廣告系列
items.title_en: Google begins mandatory DSA-to-AI Max upgrade — some campaigns already auto-migrated in September
items.summary: Google 確認自 9 月起對使用自動建立素材及廣泛匹配的搜尋廣告系列自動升級至 AI Max，動態搜尋廣告 DSA 強制遷移期限定為 2027 年 2 月。
items.summary_en: Google confirms automatic AI Max upgrades began in September for Search campaigns using Automatically Created Assets and broad match; all Dynamic Search Ads face a mandatory sunset in February 2027.
items.why: Agency 需立即審查客戶廣告帳戶，識別已被自動升級的廣告系列並確認品牌安全設置。
items.why_en: Agencies must audit client accounts now to identify auto-upgraded campaigns and verify brand safety controls are still in place.
highlights: 使用自動建立素材 (ACA) 與廣告系列層級廣泛匹配的搜尋廣告，Google 已於 9 月起自動升級至 AI Max，無須廣告主手動操作。
動態搜尋廣告 (DSA) 強制升級時間表確定：2027 年 2 月起所有 DSA 廣告系列將自動遷移，不設例外。
AI Max 引入後，廣告素材生成及出價策略均由 AI 主導，Agency 須重新評估品牌安全與地區管控設置的方式。
highlights_en: Search campaigns using Automatically Created Assets (ACA) and campaign-level broad match are already being auto-upgraded to AI Max starting September — no advertiser action required.
Dynamic Search Ads face a hard sunset in February 2027 — all DSA campaigns will be auto-migrated with no exceptions.
With AI Max, ad creative and bidding strategy are AI-driven — agencies must re-evaluate how brand safety controls and geographic restrictions are configured.

items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.title: OpenAI ChatGPT 廣告自服務系統向歐洲 31 個市場及印度開放，電商品牌即起須提交商品目錄
items.title_en: OpenAI opens ChatGPT Ads self-serve to 31 European markets and India — e-commerce brands must submit product feeds now
items.summary: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 廣告自服務平台正式向歐洲 31 個市場、印度、中東及北非開放，同時要求電商廣告主必須提交商品目錄方可出現於購物結果。
items.summary_en: OpenAI opens ChatGPT Ads self-serve access across 31 European markets, India, Middle East, and North Africa. E-commerce advertisers must submit product feeds to appear in shopping responses.
items.why: Agency 可即時為歐洲及印度客戶開立帳戶，電商商品目錄整合是優先的技術準備項目。
items.why_en: Agencies can now onboard European and India clients to ChatGPT Ads; product feed integration is the first action item for e-commerce brands.
highlights: ChatGPT 廣告自服務後台現已向歐洲 31 個市場、印度、中東及北非的廣告主全面開放。
電商廣告主即日起須提交商品目錄 (Product Feed)，方可令廣告出現於 ChatGPT 的購物意圖回應中。
ChatGPT 廣告的初期 CPC 低於 Google 市場基準，轉化追蹤尚不成熟，現階段適合搶先佔位而非倚賴精確效果評估。
highlights_en: ChatGPT Ads self-serve dashboard is now open to advertisers in 31 European markets, India, the Middle East, and North Africa.
E-commerce brands must submit product feeds immediately to appear in ChatGPT's shopping-intent responses.
ChatGPT Ads CPCs are currently below Google benchmarks, but conversion tracking is still immature — ideal for early positioning, not precision performance measurement.

items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.title: Google AI Mode 廣告滲透率升至約 25%，品牌可見度策略需全面升級
items.title_en: Google AI Mode ads now appear in ~25% of results — brand visibility strategy must evolve for AI search
items.summary: Google 公布廣告已出現於約 25% 的 AI 驅動搜尋結果，並發布品牌在 AI 搜尋介面中提升可見度的最佳實踐，Search Console 同步推出 AI 搜尋可見度報告。
items.summary_en: Google reveals ads now appear in approximately 25% of AI-powered search results, and launches new best-practice guidance and Search Console AI visibility reports to help brands appear in AI search experiences.
items.why: AI 搜尋廣告滲透率快速上升，SEO 與 SEM 策略需整合 AI 搜尋可見度評估。
items.why_en: AI search ads are scaling fast — agencies need to integrate AI search visibility measurement into both SEO and SEM strategies.
highlights: Google AI Mode 與 AI Overviews 整合後，廣告已出現於約 25% 的 AI 驅動搜尋結果，較整合前大幅提升。
Google 發布 AI 搜尋品牌曝光最佳實踐：優化品牌權威性內容、確保商品資料完整、透過 Performance Max 覆蓋 AI 搜尋版位。
Search Console 現已推出 AI 搜尋可見度報告，廣告主可追蹤品牌在 AI Overviews 中的出現頻率與點擊數據。
highlights_en: Ads now appear in approximately 25% of AI-powered search results following the AI Mode and AI Overviews integration — a significant increase.
Google's AI search visibility best practices: strengthen authoritative brand content, ensure complete product data, and use Performance Max to cover AI search placements.
Search Console now offers AI search visibility reports, letting advertisers track brand appearances and clicks within AI Overviews.

items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.title: Google AI Max 推出跨廣告系列 A/B 測試及升級版 Performance Planner，9 月全面開放
items.title_en: Google AI Max adds cross-campaign A/B testing and upgraded Performance Planner — live across accounts in September
items.summary: Google 為 AI Max 推出跨廣告系列 A/B 測試功能及升級版 Performance Planner，廣告主可在保留品牌安全管控的前提下安全評估 AI Max 成效，並以一鍵方式套用預算建議。
items.summary_en: Google launches multi-campaign A/B testing and an upgraded Performance Planner for AI Max, letting advertisers safely evaluate performance while retaining brand controls, and apply budget recommendations with one click.
items.why: A/B 測試讓 Agency 可在不影響現有廣告系列的情況下評估 AI Max 成效，為強制遷移前做好準備。
items.why_en: Agencies can now A/B test AI Max against existing campaigns safely — essential groundwork before mandatory DSA migration arrives in February 2027.
highlights: Multi-Campaign A/B Test 功能現已上線，可在同一實驗中同時測試多個搜尋廣告系列的預算及 ROI 目標。
品牌與地區管控設定可在 AI Max 實驗組中啟用，解決品牌保護與 AI 自動化測試之間的衝突。
升級版 Performance Planner 可預覽出價與預算調整效果，並提供一鍵套用功能，大幅縮短廣告優化周期。
highlights_en: Multi-Campaign A/B testing is now live, letting advertisers test budgets and ROI targets across multiple Search campaigns in a single experiment.
Brand and location controls can now be enabled within AI Max experiment arms, removing the key barrier to safe A/B testing.
The upgraded Performance Planner now previews the impact of bid and budget changes, with a one-click apply option that significantly shortens the optimisation cycle.

items.title: Kling AI 官方橫評 10 款 AI 影片生成模型：選對模型省掉反覆生成
items.title_en: Kling AI publishes head-to-head comparison of 10 AI video generation models for content creators
items.summary: Kling AI 官方對比 10 款主流 AI 影片生成模型，涵蓋動態品質、角色一致性、原生音效、多鏡頭控制及 4K 輸出，幫助廣告創作者按項目需求選擇合適工具。
items.summary_en: Kling AI's official head-to-head comparison of 10 AI video models covers motion quality, character consistency, native audio, multi-shot control, and 4K output — helping ad creators match the right tool to each project.
items.why: 廣告製作選錯模型直接浪費生成配額，這份對比有助 Agency 為不同廣告項目建立標準選模流程。
items.why_en: Picking the wrong model wastes production credits — this guide helps agencies standardise model selection for different campaign types.
highlights: Video 3.0 適合 Prompt 驅動的創意廣告影片；Omni 版本則更適合需要重用角色或產品參考形象的項目。
Native Audio 功能支援中、英、日、韓、西班牙五種語言，可直接生成多語言廣告素材。
選模原則：先確定物料來源（純文字或圖片）及製作需求，沒有一款模型適合所有場景。
highlights_en: Video 3.0 suits prompt-driven creative ads; the Omni model is better for projects requiring reusable character or product reference visuals.
Native Audio supports five languages (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish), enabling direct multilingual ad production.
Model selection principle: determine source material type (text or image) and production scope first — no single model fits all use cases.

items.title: Kling AI 橫評 10 款圖轉影片工具：靜態產品圖直接生成廣告影片
items.title_en: Kling AI compares 10 image-to-video AI tools: turn static product photos into ad videos without filming
items.summary: Kling AI 對比 10 款圖轉影片工具的動態品質、風格控制力與平台支援，為廣告主提供以靜態產品圖直接生成動態廣告素材的選型指引。
items.summary_en: Kling AI compares 10 image-to-video tools on motion quality, style control, and platform support, guiding marketers on converting static product photos directly into video ad creatives.
items.why: 電商及品牌廣告常需將產品靜圖升級成影片，正確選擇工具可壓低製作成本並加快上線速度。
items.why_en: E-commerce brands routinely need to animate product photos into video ads — picking the right tool directly cuts production cost and launch time.
highlights: 圖轉影片工具可將現有產品靜照直接升級為動態廣告素材，毋需安排新的拍攝行程。
各工具在動態自然度、風格控制與輸出格式支援上差異顯著，須按實際使用場景選擇。
Kling Image-to-Video 的 Motion Control 功能支援從參考影片或內置動態素材庫套用動作效果。
highlights_en: Image-to-video tools convert existing product photos into video ad creatives without requiring new filming.
Tools vary significantly in motion naturalness, style control, and supported export formats — match selection to use case.
Kling's Motion Control lets creators apply movement from a reference video or choose from a built-in Motion Library.

items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.title: IKEA 香港聯手 TBWA\HK 推出「為所愛騰出空間」，以本地情感切入收納廣告
items.title_en: IKEA Hong Kong and TBWA\HK launch 'Make Space for What You Love' — local emotional insight drives storage campaign
items.summary: IKEA 香港攜手 TBWA\HK 推出「Make Space for What You Love」整合廣告，以四款儲物產品為核心，透過香港本地生活情感連結小空間居住文化，覆蓋電視廣告、MTR 站佔領及社交媒體。
items.summary_en: IKEA HK and TBWA\Hong Kong launch 'Make Space for What You Love' — an integrated campaign connecting four storage products to distinct Hong Kong cultural insights, running across TV, MTR domination, and social media.
items.why: 示範本地化情感策略如何在功能性品類中脫穎而出，為港澳 Agency 提供可參考的在地化創意框架。
items.why_en: Demonstrates how localised emotional storytelling can differentiate a functional product category — a replicable framework for HK agencies pitching brand work.
highlights: 活動以「沒有人因為有空間才保留東西，是因為割捨不了」為創意核心，將四款儲物產品分別對應四種香港生活情境。
媒體部署涵蓋電視廣告、MTR 站佔領及數位社交，以整合手法強化「騰出空間」的情感主題。
IKEA 與 TBWA\HK 的合作策略顯示，即使在 AI 廣告工具普及的環境下，本地文化洞察仍是差異化的核心競爭優勢。
highlights_en: The campaign core insight — people keep things not because they have space, but because they cannot let go — maps four storage products to four distinct Hong Kong life scenarios.
Media spans TV commercials, MTR station domination, and digital social, amplifying the emotional 'make space' theme with consistency.
The IKEA × TBWA\HK strategy shows that local cultural insight remains a core competitive advantage even as AI ad tools commoditise production.

items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.title: OpenAI 廣告業務 200 天達年化 10 億美元，衝擊傳統廣告生態格局
items.title_en: OpenAI's ad business hits $1B annualised run rate in just 200 days, disrupting the advertising industry
items.summary: OpenAI 廣告業務僅用 200 天便突破年化 10 億美元收入規模，成為增速最快的 AI 廣告平台，廣告行業對預算分流的關注隨之升溫。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads business reached $1 billion in annualised revenue in just 200 days — faster than any previous ad platform launch — prompting the industry to re-evaluate budget allocation strategies.
items.why: ChatGPT 廣告崛起速度遠超預期，部分 Google 及 Meta 預算將加速流向 AI 平台，Agency 須盡早布局。
items.why_en: ChatGPT Ads' meteoric rise signals budget flows shifting faster than expected — agencies need an AI advertising strategy now, not next year.
highlights: OpenAI 廣告業務從零到年化 10 億美元，僅用 200 天，打破所有主流廣告平台的增速紀錄。
目前廣告主以科技、電商及金融行業為主，受眾集中於 ChatGPT Plus 高收入訂閱用戶群。
廣告業界對 ChatGPT 廣告成效評價兩極：部分廣告主反映 CPC 偏低，另一部分則指轉化追蹤尚不成熟。
highlights_en: OpenAI's ad business went from zero to $1B annualised revenue in 200 days — the fastest ramp of any major ad platform to date.
Current advertisers are concentrated in tech, e-commerce, and finance, reaching primarily ChatGPT Plus high-value subscribers.
Industry reactions are mixed: some advertisers see low CPCs as an opportunity, while others cite immature conversion tracking as a barrier.

items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.title: WPP 年內累計裁員逾萬一千人，Gartner 預測 Agency 費用佔比 2030 年跌至 15%
items.title_en: WPP passes 11,000 job cuts; Gartner forecasts agency fees will fall to 15% of marketing budgets by 2030
items.summary: WPP 年內累計裁員逾一萬一千人；Gartner 預測 Agency 服務費在行銷預算中的佔比將由現時 19% 跌至 2030 年的 15%，AI 自動化是主因。
items.summary_en: WPP has cut over 11,000 jobs this year as AI-driven workflow automation reduces headcount needs. Gartner forecasts agency fees will fall from 19% to 15% of marketing budgets by 2030.
items.why: 大型 Holdco 持續瘦身，獨立及精品 Agency 的競爭機遇正在開放，大灣區 Agency 可趁勢出擊。
items.why_en: Holdco consolidation creates a window for independent and boutique agencies to win clients displaced by the restructuring.
highlights: WPP 年內累計裁員逾一萬一千人，反映全球 Holdco 以 AI 取代人力的速度遠超業界預期。
Gartner 預測 Agency 服務費佔行銷預算比例將由現時 19% 降至 2030 年的 15%，AI 工具是主要替代力量。
大型 Holdco 持續收縮，為大灣區規模靈活的獨立 Agency 創造搶佔客戶的機遇。
highlights_en: WPP has cut more than 11,000 jobs this year, reflecting a faster-than-expected pace of AI replacing human headcount across holdco operations.
Gartner forecasts agency service fees will fall from 19% to 15% of marketing budgets by 2030, driven primarily by AI tool adoption.
Holdco downsizing creates a market opportunity for nimble independent agencies in the Greater Bay Area to capture newly available clients.

items.title: Kling AI 完整教學：五段式 Prompt 公式一步步生成品牌廣告影片
items.title_en: Kling AI's full tutorial: a five-part prompt formula for generating brand video ads step by step
items.summary: Kling AI 官方教學以「場景＋主體＋動作＋音效＋風格」五段式 Prompt 公式，逐步指導如何用 Kling 3.0 生成多鏡頭品牌廣告影片，涵蓋 Multi-Shot、角色參考與 Native Audio 功能。
items.summary_en: Kling AI's official step-by-step guide introduces a five-part prompt formula (Scene + Subject + Movement + Audio + Style) to generate multi-shot brand video ads using Kling 3.0, covering Multi-Shot, Character Reference, and Native Audio.
items.why: 即學即用的 Prompt 框架幫助廣告 Creative 減少反覆生成次數，縮短廣告製作周期。
items.why_en: An immediately applicable prompt formula that reduces creative iteration cycles and speeds up ad video production for agency teams.
highlights: Prompt 公式：「場景＋主體＋動作＋音效＋風格或情感或鏡頭語言」，每個鏡頭聚焦一個動作，避免複合指令。
Multi-Shot 功能可控制鏡頭次序及時長；Custom Multi-Shot 更可為每個分鏡自訂獨立提示詞。
優化次序：先修最弱的元素，使用 Character Reference 保持品牌角色一致性，音效最後加入。
highlights_en: Five-part prompt formula: Scene + Subject + Movement + Audio + Style/Emotion/Camera angle. Keep each shot focused on one action — avoid compound instructions.
Multi-Shot controls shot order and duration; Custom Multi-Shot lets you add a dedicated prompt to each individual cut.
Optimise in order: fix the weakest element first, use Character Reference for brand character consistency, add audio last.
